import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, t;
    static String[] a, b;
    static int[][] dist1 = new int[30][30];
    static int[][] dist2 = new int[30][30];
    static int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static ArrayList<Edge>[] g;
    static int[] level, it;

    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static void add_edge(int from, int to, int cap) {
        g[from].add(new Edge(to, g[to].size(), cap));
        g[to].add(new Edge(from, g[from].size() - 1, 0));
    }

    static boolean ok(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n;
    }

    static void bfs1(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) Arrays.fill(dist1[i], 1000000000);
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        dist1[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = x + dx[i], ny = y + dy[i];
                if (ok(nx, ny) && dist1[nx][ny] >= 1000000000 && b[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y') {
                    dist1[nx][ny] = dist1[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(s);
        level[s] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : g[v]) {
                if (level[e.to] == -1 && e.cap > 0) {
                    level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.add(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[t] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int t, int f) {
        if (v == t) return f;
        for (int i = it[v]; i < g[v].size(); i++) {
            Edge e = g[v].get(i);
            if (level[e.to] == level[v] + 1 && e.cap > 0) {
                int d = dfs(e.to, t, Math.min(f, e.cap));
                if (d > 0) {
                    e.cap -= d;
                    g[e.to].get(e.rev).cap += d;
                    return d;
                }
            }
            it[v]++;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int max_flow(int s, int t) {
        int flow = 0;
        while (bfs(s, t)) {
            Arrays.fill(it, 0);
            int f;
            while ((f = dfs(s, t, 1000000000)) > 0) flow += f;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static void bfs2(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) Arrays.fill(dist2[i], 1000000000);
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        dist2[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            if (dist2[x][y] >= dist1[x][y]) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = x + dx[i], ny = y + dy[i];
                if (ok(nx, ny) && dist2[nx][ny] >= 1000000000 && a[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && dist2[x][y] + 1 <= dist1[nx][ny]) {
                    dist2[nx][ny] = dist2[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        a = new String[n];
        b = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = sc.next();
        int wx = 0, wy = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            b[i] = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (b[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    // Replace with 'Y' in both grids
                    char[] aChars = a[i].toCharArray();
                    aChars[j] = 'Y';
                    a[i] = new String(aChars);
                    char[] bChars = b[i].toCharArray();
                    bChars[j] = 'Y';
                    b[i] = new String(bChars);
                    wx = i;
                    wy = j;
                }
            }
        }
        bfs1(wx, wy);
        int gridSize = n; // save original grid size
        int source = 0;
        int sink = 2 * gridSize * gridSize + 1;
        int nodeCount = 2 * gridSize * gridSize + 2;
        g = new ArrayList[nodeCount];
        for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++) g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        level = new int[nodeCount];
        it = new int[nodeCount];

        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; j++) {
                if (a[i].charAt(j) == 'Y') continue;
                int what = i * gridSize + j + 1;
                int what2 = gridSize * gridSize + i * gridSize + j + 1;
                int capA = a[i].charAt(j) - '0';
                int capB = b[i].charAt(j) - '0';
                add_edge(source, what, capA);
                add_edge(what2, sink, capB);
                bfs2(i, j);
                for (int x = 0; x < gridSize; x++) {
                    for (int y = 0; y < gridSize; y++) {
                        if (b[x].charAt(y) == 'Y' || dist2[x][y] > t) continue;
                        add_edge(what, gridSize * gridSize + x * gridSize + y + 1, capA);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        n = nodeCount; // update n for max_flow (not used further)
        System.out.println(max_flow(source, sink));
        sc.close();
    }
}
